text:
maria: Heads-up — we have a deploy scheduled during the 09:30 PT change window. Plan: rollout service v2.3.1 and enable feature flag `enable_search_autocomplete` gradually (10% -> 50% -> 100%) over ~25m. Pinning model routing to prod-v1.8 for the first 60m as a safety. Release notes draft: https://redwood.internal/releases/v2.3.1 (see notes). Anyone add concerns?

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: 2024-06-12T09:30:00PT. Canary batch = 10 instances. FF plan: 10% @t+3m, 50% @t+12m, 100% @t+25m. Will post canary health updates.

sam: I'll monitor SLOs (p50/p95/p99 latency + 5xx rate). Add a telemetry gate: if p99 > 200ms sustained for 5m OR 5xx spike > 0.5% for 5m, we rollback and pin. Can we make the gate automated?

jess: tagging on release notes — please include the pinned-model line and the expected token-cost delta. Suggested copy: "Pin model routing to prod-v1.8 for warm start; FF enables autocomplete which may increase short-tail requests by ~8-12%."

tariq: ops-oncall here. I'll be watching infra metrics and tracing. @deploy-bot please expose a quick rollback command in the thread so I can execute without hunting. Also confirm who has deploy token.

deploy-bot: Quick rollback command (operator):
```
redwoodctl ff set enable_search_autocomplete 0 --reason "rollback: telemetry gate breached" --trace-id $TRACE
redwoodctl routing pin model prod-v1.8 --duration 60m
```

maria: Thanks. Add to runbook: immediately notify #incidents if rollback happens, and attach the last 10 error traces. We'll do a short postmortem if we hit the gate.

sam: Small tweak to the gate: also check the downstream cache hit ratio — if it drops >7% we should pause the FF ramp and investigate.

jess: Copy for release notes updated and pushed to the docs page. Also added the rollback snippet.

deploy-bot: Canary health: all good at 10% after 4m. No elevated 5xx. Scaling to 50% now.

sam: Seeing a small p95 blip at t+9m but back to baseline at t+11m. Holding.

deploy-bot: Reached 50% @t+13m. Monitoring.

tariq: Not seeing any cache hit drop on infra dashboard. Traces look clean.

sam: p99 is 210ms for one short window (2m) at t+14m — below our 5m sustained threshold. Continuing ramp.

maria: Thanks all. Proceed to 100% when you have green for another 8m.

deploy-bot: Reached 100% @t+26m. Full rollout complete. Posting final checklist: pinned model prod-v1.8 will be unpinned after 60m unless rollback triggered.

jess: Leaving note in release notes: rollout completed, pinned model will auto-unpin at +60m.

sam: I'll leave a monitoring watch for another 30m then hand off to oncall rotation.

tariq: All good from infra. Closing the active watch in 35m. :white_check_mark:

maria: Great job. Leaving this thread for post-deploy followups. If anything odd, reopen here and tag the oncall. :thumbsup:
